# GLM (vendored)

Header-only math library, https://github.com/g-truc/glm. Only the `glm/` headers and the licence
(`copying.txt`) are kept; they used to be a git submodule.

Version: commit `6f14f4792a0cde5d0cf2c910506724d61cb95834` (`1.0.0-139-g6f14f479`).
To update, replace `glm/` with the same folder from a newer GLM release and record the version here.
